annotations.title: Confirm a fact on a Meridian Dispatch page is still right

description: Tell the Meridian Dispatch desk that a fact on one of its pages is still correct, after checking it yourself against a current, authoritative source (the place's official website, an operator or government page). Use it after list_pages_to_verify, or whenever your own research confirms something a page says. If the fact is wrong instead, use suggest_edit. Quote checked_text exactly as the page (or this server's answer) gives it and pass the source you checked; a quote not on the page, or a source on meridiandispatch.com, is refused. The page is marked confirmed today and moves to the back of the verify list; the page itself does not change. Returns whether it was recorded.

checked_text.description: The fact you checked, quoted from the page, e.g. a facts_to_check text.

source_url.description: Where you checked it: a current, authoritative page that is not on meridiandispatch.com.

url.description: The meridiandispatch.com page, as returned by list_pages_to_verify or in source.url.
